exposure: Verbal communication of midwives and physicians in the delivery room
Non-verbal communication of midwives and physicians in the delivery room
Experience of stillbirth or neonatal death
outcome: Women's general satisfaction with birth care
Women's satisfaction with verbal communication of healthcare providers
Women's satisfaction with non-verbal communication of healthcare providers
cohort: The study included 1196 women from Erbil city, Iraq, who gave birth in the year prior to data collection between January and March 2019.
finding: Women's satisfaction with verbal and nonverbal communication of healthcare providers in the delivery room was significantly associated with their general satisfaction with birth care.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between January and March 2019, reflecting experiences from births within the preceding year.
